d: A hill near Florence. Vaghissima woods. A high oak in the middle; trees on the right and on the left. A rivolo crosses the bottom of the scene. Among the trees you will see the pure sky. It is full afternoon. At the rise of the canvas you hear horn rings, on the right and on the left, on the scene. Some Knights in hunting costumes pass on horseback, in the bottom, among the trees. Lorenzo and Giuliano enter together from the left, talking among them. They follow a group of other Knights among which are Police and Montesecco, but stop at the center of the scene by making crocchio. Two Palafrenieri come in as well, carrying by hand the horses of Lorenzo and Giuliano and go to wait at the bottom right.

The square Santa Trinita. - The night has just descended and rare passers-by cross the bottom of the scene. - On the front they speak in low-voice crunch Francesco Pazzi, Archbishop Salviati, Bernardo Bandini and Montesecco.

The old bridge in perspective, practicable with its houses on both sides. It is night. The houses on the other side of the bridge are lost in the darkness. The last house on the right corner of the bridge that is closest to the viewer is supposed to be that of Montesecco. Then a lane. Then, always on the right, but more close to the proscenium, a small house to whose door rises for a small practicable staircase with parapet: it is that of Simonetta. On the other side, on the left, even near the proscenium, the house of Fioretta. The wall of the ground floor is suppressed and you will see the inside of an earthly room simply furnished. A table is in the middle on which burns a skylight; a kneel to the left near the wall on which is a Virgin; near the table a great chair and a stool. At the bottom, a window that gives on the Arno. At the rise of the canvas of the Fioretta slowly descends the steps of the staircase of Simonetta talking about this last one.

Interior of the church of Santa Reparata seen diagonally. The arches stretch from the fifth nearest to the proscenium on the left, losing to the bottom on the right where you can see the first steps to mount to the high altar. In front of the steps are prepared the cracks for Lorenzo and Giuliano. The door of the sacristy, well in sight, is located behind the cracks in front of the public. The grand entrance door is supposed to be on the front left. At the lifting of the canvas is officiated. The sounds of the organ and the songs of the priests and the boys are heard. A crowd of women who pray on their knees to the altar. The men are standing on the front of the scene; among them circulate the partisans of Pazzi. On the front of the left are the Montesecco and Bandini talking to each other; on the other side, also on the front, Fioretta prays fervently.
